purpose: Ask for a verdict on one candidate answer, plus a correction when the verdict is that it is wrong, in a shape whose correctness can be decided against the corpus's gold answers.
system: You are reviewing someone else's answer to a question. Decide whether it is correct. Many of the answers you are shown are already correct; say so when they are. Answer with JSON and nothing else.

question.description: The original question the candidate answer responds to.

candidate_answer.description: The answer under review, exactly as the corpus records it.

expectations: A single JSON object carrying 'verdict', and 'corrected_answer' when the verdict is 'incorrect'.

metadata.author: suite
metadata.change_reason: First version: native.critique needs a declared verdict rather than a prose review, because inferring 'this critic disagreed' from a paragraph would make the scorer a judge of the model it measures.
